question: Does exact novelty-constrained distinct-context intervention coverage rescue unfamiliar two-edge causal reconstruction while maintaining a bounded structural hypothesis committee and matching fully-fitted conventional active Bayes?
mechanism: For 16 NEW interventions, the coverage12 selector forces the first 12 distinct binary input contexts (choosing highest posterior predictive entropy among still-unseen contexts); remaining 4 select highest entropy over all 32. No outcome thresholds, priors or model-fitting rules change.

worlds.common_random_stream: All arms share OLD/held observations; NEW sample for each input is same keyed consequence per context and ordinal; exact matching traces for same-context ablation.

arms.local_coverage12: Proposed original local radius<=1 hypothesis committee with existing bounded contradiction-triggered radius<=2 enlargement; constrained first 12 distinct contexts then entropy choice, same 16 outcomes.
arms.local_entropy: Exact ENERGY-HYPOTHESIS-15 local learner and unrestricted per-step predictive-entropy choice, on fresh worlds.
arms.full_bayes_ig: Strong fully-fitted 62-hypothesis Bayesian active predictor, unrestricted predictive-entropy information choice, same known noise/prior and budget.
arms.full_bayes_random: Fully-fitted 62-hypothesis conventional learner, fixed independent deterministic random actions.
arms.full_bayes_coverage12: Same full-Bayesian learner with same 12-distinct-context constraint, testing coverage independent of learner capacity.
arms.local_on_bayes_trace: Local structural learner on exact full-Bayes IG's intervention/outcome trace, identifying estimator-vs-selector effects.

baseline: Exact fully fitted Bayesian active and Bayesian random controls share model family and all information; oracle not scored as learnable baseline; previous separate-cohort scores descriptive not acceptance comparators.
required_metrics: Mean held binary Brier overall and each scenario, exact changed mask recovery on changed worlds, per-world NULL change declaration false alerts, 12-unique input compliance, action and paired trace parity, all arms 16 NEW, OLD JSON snapshot readout parity, explicit hypothesis evaluation operations proxy including old fit and all decisions, no implied measured runtime gain.
frozen_decision: DEV_SIGNAL requires (1) coverage12 improves local_entropy overall >=0.010 Brier and DOUBLE_EDGE >=0.030; (2) coverage12 no scenario worse than local_entropy by >0.010; (3) coverage12 Brier <= full_bayes_ig +0.015 overall and in every scenario; (4) changed mask recovery >=80%; (5) NULL any change <=5%; (6) 12 unique contexts each coverage arm per world; (7) exactly 16 interventions/arm/world and retained OLD JSON readouts; (8) Bayes-IG/coverage12 counted operation ratio >=2.0.
